summary: Verified the Net Metering close-task handoff bug fix end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_net_metering_assign.py with 8 tests covering the 9 required backend checks; 7 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing NM ECP whose 'Request Net Metering' was already completed on the second run — the primary pre-prereq 400 assertion was validated on the first run against ECP ba3112c3). All authoritative checks pass: REGISTRATION gets 403 on Close NM, INSTALLATION_MANAGER assign in NM before prereq -> 400, assign after prereq -> 200 (responsible_user/name set to instmem), non-assigned INSTALLATION_MEMBER -> 403 on Close NM, assigned INSTALLATION_MEMBER -> 200 and stage auto-advances NM -> REGISTRATION_2 with correct history entry, INSTALLATION-stage regression assignment still works. Frontend: verified via Playwright — INSTALLATION_MANAGER sees 'Assigned · Manish Install-Member' via data-testid=close-nm-assigned; the assigned INSTALLATION_MEMBER (instmem) sees data-testid=complete-task-<id> and clicking it advanced ECP c9589b18 to REGISTRATION_2 (confirmed via Workflow History showing 'Net Metering → Registration 2 · Manish Install-Member'). REGISTRATION filter (Close NM hidden from Stage Work list) is verified by code review (ECPDetail.jsx line 94-96 filters out 'Close Net Metering' for isNM && REGISTRATION) and reinforced by backend 403 enforcement; runtime body-scan check gave a false positive because 'Close Net Metering' also appears in the Workflow History timeline.

minor.issue: When INSTALLATION_MEMBER completes 'Close Net Metering' the stage auto-advances to REGISTRATION_2 and the response wrapper (get_ecp) then returns 404 because ecp_filter_for_role hides REGISTRATION_2 ECPs from INSTALLATION_MEMBER role. The underlying task-complete + stage transition succeed, but the client sees a 404 body. Consider returning a minimal success payload (or bypassing the scope filter on this immediate post-write response) so the UI does not see a spurious 404 on a successful action.

integration_issues.issue: Because backend response returns 404 after auto-advance, frontend logs a 404 network error; the UI still refreshes and correctly reflects the advance (Registration 2). No functional break, but the console shows an error.

action_items: Optional: adjust complete_task's return path so INSTALLATION_MEMBER doesn't receive 404 immediately after successful Close-NM completion (auto-advance out of INSTALLATION_MEMBER visibility). Return an ecp payload fetched with an admin-scoped or bypass filter, or return a lightweight {status: 'advanced', current_stage: 'REGISTRATION_2'} to avoid the client-side 404.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _advance_stage() correctly clears responsible_user/responsible_user_name for every target stage via the else block (line 876-878). The special-cased INSTALLATION branch re-purposes current_team to INSTALLATION_MANAGER for the awaiting-assignment gate — no leak of the previous stage's responsible_user into NM.

server.py assign_installation() properly branches on stage: NET_METERING requires 'Request Net Metering from CSPDCL' to be completed before allowing Close-NM assignment; any other non-INSTALLATION stage returns 400 — matches spec.

server.py complete_task() correctly enforces team==INSTALLATION_MEMBER with responsible_user==user.id for Close NM. Combined with the response 404 above, the post-complete UX may look erroneous — see minor issue.

ECPDetail.jsx line 94-96 filter is correct (task_name !== 'Close Net Metering' for REGISTRATION); Close NM chip/UI section renders assign / assigned / awaiting-prereq states correctly for INSTALLATION_MANAGER and INSTALLATION_MEMBER.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 assigned/complete paths passed; REGISTRATION filter verified by code + backend 403)

seed_data_creation: None. Used ECPs ba3112c3-... (advanced to REGISTRATION_2 during test_07) and c9589b18-... (advanced to REGISTRATION_2 during frontend Mark Done). Both were pre-existing NM ECPs. After the run, only 1 partial NM ECP (9e777f7e) remains — it has legacy single 'Net Metering' task (no 5-task set) and can't be used for future NM regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After this run, only ECP 9e777f7e is left in NET_METERING and it has legacy schema (single 'Net Metering' task). To re-test the NM flow, drive a fresh ECP from INSTALLATION -> NET_METERING (there was one at b2d60ebb in INSTALLATION READY_TO_INSTALL). The test file /app/backend/tests/test_net_metering_assign.py auto-discovers a suitable NM ECP; it will skip test_03 if no fresh-state NM ECP exists.
rca of the issue: The bug: previously entering NET_METERING kept the Installation-stage responsible_user, allowing REGISTRATION to complete an INSTALLATION_MEMBER-team task via the pre-carried assignee. Fix (server.py _advance_stage): the else branch always sets responsible_user/name to None on stage transitions to NM (and other stages). Fix (server.py assign_installation): now accepts stage NET_METERING when 'Request Net Metering from CSPDCL' has been completed, then sets responsible_user for Close NM. Fix (ECPDetail.jsx): filters out 'Close Net Metering' from the REGISTRATION stage-work list. All three layers verified.
